subject: Re: Urgent: Unexpected API surge — temporary headroom request
messages:
From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@fastretail.com
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected API surge — temporary headroom request

Hi Ben,

Quick heads up — we had an anomalous rollout of a marketing experiment this morning and traffic to the recommendation endpoint spiked ~6x for ~3 hours. Our infra team throttled most of it but a chunk still hit Redwood and pushed us past our provisioned quota.

Ops asked whether we can get a temporary increase to rate limits for the next 72 hours while we roll back the experiment and flatten ingestion. Ideally we'd get:
- immediate headroom to handle 2x our current peak for 72 hours
- assurance we won't be invoiced at standard overrun rates for the first incident window (it's an internal misconfig)

I've attached a small export of today's calls. Can you advise the fastest path? We're trying to avoid degraded user experience this weekend — any temporary uplift or grace would help a lot.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Stone
Customer Success Manager, FastRetail
attachments: fastretail-usage-q2.csv (CSV, 82KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@fastretail.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected API surge — temporary headroom request

Emma — thanks for the flag and for sending the export. I pulled the attached CSV and can see the spike pattern you described. Short answer: we can provision short-term headroom and put a one-time protective credit in place, with a small set of approvals. Proposed path: 

1) Immediate provisional uplift: +2x peak throughput for 72 hours (starts the moment we flip the flag). This is a soft limit — we'll keep routing to lower-cost compatible model variants if necessary to maintain latency SLOs.

2) Grace pricing window: waive standard overrun surcharge for the first 72 hours, then retroactively true-up at a negotiated blended rate if usage remains elevated after the grace window.

3) One-time credit: propose a 30% credit on the overrun tokens incurred during the incident window, contingent on a short mutual action plan (MAP) — commit from FastRetail to a post-mortem and a follow-up quota baseline conversation.

Ask from your side: confirm the time window you want uplift for and confirm the Ops contact who will manage rollback so we can coordinate flags. From our side I'll triage routing and temporarily raise the tenant pool.

I've cc'd Grace (sales) and Laura (finance) for quick approvals on the credit and the blended true-up terms. If we get a green light I'll issue a provisional uplift and send a one-page confirmation (DocuSign not required).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attachments: provisional-uplift-summary.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected API surge — temporary headroom request

Grace / Laura — looping you in. FastRetail had a 6x spike for ~3 hours and is asking for a 72-hour +2x headroom and a waive of overrun surcharge for that window. I outlined a provisional path (uplift + 30% one-time credit on the overrun, MAP required).

Internal notes (Ben):
- Customer is healthy and >$60k/mo usage; strong expansion potential — happy path to preserve UX this weekend.
- Risk: setting precedent for future spikes. I suggested the MAP and a post-incident quota baseline convo.
- Timing: Ops wants immediate action.

Can we green-light the provisional uplift now and the 30% credit on the overrun volume? If finance needs different wording (blended rate vs % credit) let's land it quickly so I can flip the switch.

— Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected API surge — temporary headroom request

Thanks for the context. Finance is OK to approve the provisional uplift and a one-time credit under these constraints: 

- Approve provisional +2x headroom for 72 hours starting when Ben executes (ops ticket required).
- Approve a 30% credit applied to the token overrun amount for the incident window, capped at $18,000.
- Credit contingent on FastRetail signing the MAP doc within 7 business days (MAP: brief post-mortem + quota baseline conversation).
- Any usage beyond the capped true-up will be charged at a negotiated blended overrun rate of $0.0009/token (instead of the standard overrun rate).

Ben — you can proceed to flip the uplift once Ops confirms rollback window and the customer accepts the MAP terms. Please capture the final numbers and create a ticket for billing reconciliation (link to HubSpot deal in related_links).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Temporary uplift executed — next steps

Emma — quick update: we've enabled the provisional +2x headroom for 72 hours starting 2027-03-20T15:00:00-07:00. Per finance, we've approved a one-time 30% credit on the overrun capped at $18k; any usage beyond that will be billed at the blended overrun rate $0.0009/token.

Next steps for you:
- Ops: please confirm rollback ETA and send a single e-mail to ops@redwood.ai so we have the ticket reference.
- Sign the MAP: I'll send the one-page MAP doc for signature; it just covers a 30-minute post-mortem and a quota baseline sync.
- I'll follow up with the billing reconciliation once the incident window closes and we compute the true-up.

Thanks for the quick coordination. Happy to hop on a short call if you want to run through the MAP.

Best,
Ben
